items.label: California State Assembly
items.text: Member of the California State Assembly, 22nd District. (sources: Vote Smart https://justfacts.votesmart.org/candidate/biography/105586 [search summary, secondary]; San Mateo Daily Journal https://www.smdailyjournal.com/news/local/south-san-francisco-assemblymember-seeks-congress-seat/article_8519a342-bc71-11ec-8b31-17b96f2a2572.html [search summary, secondary])
